title: cyanthillium stelluliferum
intro: Cyanthillium stelluliferum, commonly known as Starflower, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat various health issues, such as inflammation and pain. The health benefits of Cyanthillium stelluliferum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of the plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
